title: crotalaria laburnifolia subsp. australis
intro: Crotalaria laburnifolia subsp. australis, commonly known as Australian rattlepod, is a flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. The plant is said to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. Therapeutically, it is used to treat various conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory actions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic effects.
